aboutPage.name: Irwin Arruda
aboutPage.whoamiBody: I like building things that make other devs' lives easier: design systems, CLIs, build tooling and, lately, guardrails for coding agents. I've spent years studying software architecture and testing ideas on real projects, micro-frontends most of all. I work mostly in TypeScript and React, with C#/.NET on the backend. These days, much of my work is making coding agents reliable inside a team, with ordinary guardrails applied strictly: integration tests, linting, type checks, CI and automated code review, plus the specs and skills that teach an agent the codebase.

projects.name: favo-cli
projects.description: A CLI that keeps several AI subscriptions on every computer you own, without logging in and out. Its usage command counts the tokens on this site's Usage page

projects.name: Agent Toolkit
projects.description: My global agent instructions and seven reusable skills: code review, architecture diagnosis, taking a pull request to green and more. Several follow ideas Theo Browne published in tstack

projects.name: The Chatbot
projects.description: My personal AI assistant on WhatsApp and the web: chat, todos, notes and money in one place, with a tool-calling loop over several model providers. The first version was C#/.NET with an MCP server

projects.name: Module Federation for Vite
projects.description: A fix for packages with wrong exports, merged and released in 1.2.2. I also have code accepted into TanStack Form and Ark UI

projects.name: Mobx Simple Store
projects.description: A performant alternative to MobX State Tree for creating reactive state tree stores. Removes features that cause performance bottlenecks with large datasets

projects.name: irwin-ui
projects.description: The design system behind this site, The Chatbot and favo-cli. Its two themes, Favo and Barro, are also published as editor themes on the VS Code Marketplace and Open VSX

projects.name: Study on Micro-frontends
projects.description: A hands-on study integrating React, Vue, and Svelte in one app using Webpack Module Federation with shared MobX global state

projects.name: Pro Cris App
projects.description: A scheduling and billing app for my mother's tutoring business. It logged 1,700 lessons for 32 students from 2022 to 2024

notes: Most of these tokens are cache reads: every step an agent takes re-reads the conversation so far.
The price is what the same tokens would cost at API list prices. My subscriptions covered them.
Claude Code deletes its session logs after 30 days, so most of my Claude work before mid-October 2026 is missing or only partly counted.
